stories.title: Fed raises rates to 3.75%-4% in first hike since 2023, with most officials expecting another
stories.reason: The unanimous 12-0 vote came despite direct pressure from Trump to cut, with the Fed citing elevated inflation, and 16 of 18 officials' projections pointing to at least one more hike this year.

stories.title: House votes for a third time to limit Trump's power to continue the Iran war, as 7 Republicans defect
stories.reason: The 220-204 vote saw three new GOP defectors join, with Rep. Zach Nunn saying 'sustained combat operations now require congressional authorization' -- though the measure still faces a near-certain Trump veto if it ever reaches his desk.

stories.title: EU's von der Leyen proposes Canada as the bloc's first-ever 'associate member' amid Trump's trade war
stories.reason: The unprecedented overture to move 'from CETA to an alliance for the future' comes as Trump's tariffs and talk of a '51st state' push Canada -- which sends 70% of its exports to the US -- toward deeper European ties.

stories.title: Anthropic in talks for a $100 billion raise at a $2 trillion valuation, with Nvidia eyeing a $10 billion stake
stories.reason: The potential raise, backed by an annualized revenue run rate that surged from $9 billion to $65 billion in seven months, would make Anthropic's IPO one of the largest ever if it goes ahead on Nasdaq.

stories.title: OpenAI weighs a new funding round at up to $1.5 trillion valuation ahead of a planned 2027 IPO
stories.reason: Investors have offered $1.2 trillion but OpenAI believes it's worth more, one more private round before a listing it has already pushed back to next year -- intensifying the valuation arms race with Anthropic's own pre-IPO push.

stories.title: 25 Fields Medalists, including Terence Tao, warn that AI labs' race to solve famous math problems is harming mathematics
stories.reason: The declaration follows OpenAI's disputed Navier-Stokes claim and NYU mathematician Tristan Buckmaster's allegation that his unpublished work influenced it, arguing the benchmark race raises plagiarism risks and undermines conceptual understanding.

stories.title: Kosovo's former president Hashim Thaci convicted of war crimes, sentenced to 25 years
stories.reason: The Kosovo Specialist Chambers found Thaci guilty of murdering 96 political opponents and perceived collaborators during the independence war, closing a years-long case that also convicted three co-defendants and saw Thaci resign the presidency to face trial.

stories.title: Trump claims without evidence that his 2024 Butler assassination attempt was a 'Democrat Plot'
stories.reason: Citing unspecified 'new info' -- reportedly records showing an anonymous donor funded the shooter's cremation -- Trump demanded former FBI Director Christopher Wray 'pay a price,' reopening a case the bureau closed in 2025 with the shooter's motive still unknown.
